artifact_review: The Router identified 'text_gibberish' (severity 2) and 'texture_anomaly' (severity 1). The Image Text Auditor confirmed the absence of legible text (empty blocks), which strongly supports the 'text_gibberish' finding. In AI images, the failure to render coherent text on signs/tags is a structural semantic failure, not just a minor blur. I am upgrading the severity of the text artifact to 3.5 because it breaks the illusion of a real retail environment. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found only slight compression/noise, which is negligible. The background hair smudging noted by the Router is consistent with depth-of-field simulation but lacks the crispness of real photography, supporting a minor texture anomaly.
